# OONI API

> Open data on internet censorship, collected by OONI Probe volunteers worldwide.
> Start with OONI Findings (curated, human-verified reports). Use the aggregation
> endpoint for statistics. Do not page through raw measurements.

Base URL: https://api.ooni.io

## Acceptable use

- API endpoints are meant for one-off fetches, not for live queries made on behalf of a third-party application's users.
- Bulk ingestion is not allowed. Reach out on https://slack.ooni.org or at contact@ooni.org to discuss receiving a database dump.
- Periodic fetching must stay under 1 request per second and 1000 requests per day, and cover no more than 1 year of data.
- For in-depth analysis, use the raw data in S3.

## Rules

- Prefer Findings over drawing your own conclusions from anomaly counts.
- Do not paginate `/api/v1/measurements` to count results or extract the `anomaly` field. Use `/api/v1/aggregation` instead.
- Do not loop over countries or tests. Group with `axis_y` (e.g. `axis_y=probe_cc`). For filtering, pass comma-separated values (e.g. `probe_cc=IR,RU,CN`).
- Anomaly counts on their own are misleading because they scale with measurement volume if not disaggregated by network and target. Read them against `measurement_count` and break them down by target and network (e.g. `axis_y=domain` for web_connectivity).
- Keep history locally and only re-request recent days.

## Findings

- `GET /api/v1/incidents/search` — list findings. Filters: `country_code`, `asn`, `domain`, `theme`.
- `GET /api/v1/incidents/show/{id_or_slug}` — one finding with full text.

## Aggregation

`GET /api/v1/aggregation`

- Filters: `probe_cc`, `probe_asn`, `test_name`, `domain`, `since`, `until`
- Grouping: `axis_x`, `axis_y` (e.g. `measurement_start_day`, `probe_cc`, `probe_asn`, `domain`)
- Returns: `measurement_count`, `anomaly_count`, `confirmed_count`, `failure_count`, `ok_count`

Examples:

- Websites in one country, per day:
  `/api/v1/aggregation?probe_cc=IR&test_name=web_connectivity&since=2026-09-01&until=2026-09-28&axis_x=measurement_start_day&axis_y=domain&time_grain=day`
- One app across all countries, per day:
  `/api/v1/aggregation?test_name=telegram&since=2026-09-26&until=2026-09-28&axis_x=measurement_start_day&axis_y=probe_cc&time_grain=day`

## Measurements (use sparingly)

- `GET /api/v1/measurements` — only to retrieve `measurement_uid`s. Never paginate beyond a few pages.
- `GET /api/v1/raw_measurement?measurement_uid={uid}` — one full measurement. If many raw measurements are required access them via S3, see: https://docs.ooni.org/data.

## License and citation

- OONI data is licensed under [CC BY-NC-SA 4.0](https://github.com/ooni/license/blob/master/data/LICENSE.md). Commercial use requires a specific sub-license: contact contact@ooni.org.
- Cite OONI data as:

```bibtex
@misc{ooni_data,
  author       = {{Open Observatory of Network Interference (OONI)}},
  title        = {OONI Measurement Data},
  howpublished = {\url{https://ooni.org/data}},
  note         = {Licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0}
}
```
